title: Can ‘Robots Won't Save Japan’ Save Robotics? Reviewing an Ethnography of Eldercare Automation
reasoning: The paper is a book review of an ethnography on elder care robotics. While it discusses the 'ethical basis of care' and critiques the socio-political implications (including 'technoableism') of robotics research, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics in an AI or NLP system context.
